notes.title: BLACK BOX LSS Joins the Shanghai WePlay Expo
notes.content:
[h2]WePlay Expo[/h2]
BLACK BOX LSS - The Merciful Savior will be joining the WePlay Expo in the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center from the 16th to the 17th of November. Come find us if you're going, too! We'll be waiting at booth C38!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309921/e83958102b387c9cdad5607e61ceb9ada66ba171.jpg[/img]

[b]Expo Details[/b]
Time: November 16-17
Address: World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center Hall H4, Floor B1, 1099 Guozhan Road, Pudong New District
Booth: C38 (specific location TBA)

Can't make it in person? Not to worry—you can still join in the fun online! During the expo, the BLACK BOX LSS - The Merciful Savior demo and the full version of BLACK BOX LSS - The Shining Immortal will also be available online for you to play!

Remember to add them to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435810/BLACK_BOX_LSS/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434340/BLACK_BOX_LSS/

notes.title: The Merciful Savior will participate in the WePlay Expo on November 16th!
notes.content:
[i]The Merciful Savior[/i] and [i]The Shining Immortal[/i] will be participating in the WePlay Expo in Shanghai from November 16th to 17th. We warmly invite you to come and try out the games!

I, Fif, will represent our team at this offline exhibition. Those who come to the booth will have the opportunity to experience the unreleased content from Chapter 2 of [i]The Merciful Savior[/i], along with the full version of [i]The Shining Immortal[/i]!

If you have any feedback or questions during your playthrough, feel free to chat with me (Fif) on-site! You’ll also receive random goodies from the Black Box LSS series as a thank-you for trying the games! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309921/ed19953e13a369e8993f7c3805ed1a808cf85616.png[/img]

[b]Exhibition Information [/b]
Event Date: November 16th - 17th  
Venue Address: ICBC Center, Shanghai Expo Exhibition Hall H4 (1099 Guozhan Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai)  
Booth Location: C38 (specific location details will be shared later)  
Ticket Purchase Link: [url=https://show.bilibili.com/platform/detail.html?id=93836]https://show.bilibili.com/platform/detail.html?id=93836[/url]

For those who cannot attend in person, don’t be discouraged! During the event, you can also try the demo of [i]The Merciful Savior[/i] and the full version of [i]The Shining Immortal[/i] online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435810/BLACK_BOX_LSS/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434340/BLACK_BOX_LSS/

Since the release of [i]The Merciful Savior[/i], we've received many valuable suggestions and feedback. Thank you all for your insights; we will strive to improve the game and provide a better gaming experience for everyone.
